title: Energy at home
info: Electricity is useful, and wasting it costs money and fuel.
Lights off when you leave, and a fridge door shut, are simple saves.

questions.q: When you leave an empty room, you can
options: open the fridge and walk away
the light prefers to be warm
cold air stays inside, so it uses less energy
light a room without a lamp

questions.q: A fan left on in an empty room

options: using what you need and not leaving machines running for nothing

questions.q: Type the word for power from wires and batteries that lamps use.
